newsitem.title: USA: O.J. Simpson files for new trial.
newsitem.headline: O.J. Simpson files for new trial.

text.p: Lawyers for O.J. Simpson filed a motion on Tuesday asking for a new trial for the former football star, who was found responsible last month for the deaths of his ex-wife and her friend, a court official said.
The documents filed with the Los Angeles Superior Court also asked Judge Hiroshi Fujisaki to reduce the $33.5 million damage award the jury gave to the families of the victims.

Tuesday was the deadline for Simpson's defence to file an appeal or any other motions relating to the civil trial which ended last month with the damages award. No further details of the defence motion were immediately available.
A jury in Santa Monica found Simpson responsible for the deaths of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ronald Goldman, who were found slashed to death in June 1994.
Simpson was acquitted of the murders in October 1995, but a civil suit for wrongful death was brought against him by the families of the victims.
Last week, Sharon Rufo, the mother of Goldman, filed a motion asking for Simpson to begin paying her her portion of the damages.
